decisions.reason: The embedded Skill-name matcher treats 革新 as the Skill title Đổi mới, but 掀起革新 uses 革新 compositionally as ordinary innovation/reform prose. The same item also needs generic 赛马娘 → Mã Nương, but the matcher scope should be corrected before a final keep/revise decision.

canonical_finding.concept: Skill-name matcher overmatches ordinary innovation/reform prose
canonical_finding.reason: In 掀起革新, 革新 is a common noun meaning innovation/reform rather than a Skill-name identity. Skill-title matching needs contextual narrowing in descriptive text.
